sources: recreation.gov per-site catalog for 234104 (public search API)

values.note: $25 a site per night (FS page; recreation.gov 2026 and 2027, plus tax online). Two vehicles included; $10 for a third. Senior and Access passes halve the site fee. On-site payment by cash, check or money order at the fee tube.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/purgatoire-campground ('$25 fee per site for overnight camping. Two vehicles are included in the camping fee. $10 fee for a third vehicle'; 'Fees are payable by cash, check or money order. A self-service fee tube'; 'Senior Pass and the Interagency Access Pass qualify for a 50% discount') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234104/rates (2026 and 2027 Peak Season: STANDARD/RV NONELECTRIC 25; facility_rules hasTaxes), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Three outhouses (two accessible); drinking water from a hand pump. Bear closure order in force.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/purgatoire-campground ('There are 3 outhouses, 2 are accessible'; 'Potable water is available at this site. A hand pump is available'; 'a bear closure order is in place') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234104 ('vault toilets', 'Drinking water is from a hand pump'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Two loops: a wooded loop of 14 standard/RV sites (spurs 18-35 ft; six at 25, four at 35) and a grassy meadow loop of 6 equestrian sites for horse campers (spurs to 45 ft). Grass-and-gravel aprons, all back-in. One RV per site.

sites.source: recreation.gov per-site catalog for 234104 (20 sites: 13 STANDARD NONELECTRIC + 1 RV NONELECTRIC, Max Vehicle Length 18-35; 6 EQUESTRIAN NONELECTRIC, equipment 'Horse', 22-45; all Back-In) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234104 ('laid out on two loops. One is a large grassy meadow with sites that accommodate equestrian campers and one that is wooded'; 'parking aprons are grass and gravel'; '1 RV in each campsite'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Early May to late September, weather dependent; services may be limited early and late. In 2026 first-come May 8-14 and Sept 20-26, reservable May 15 - Sept 19.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/purgatoire-campground ('This campground is open early May to late September, weather dependent') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234104/rates (2026 seasons: First-come, First-served 2026-05-08 to 05-14, Peak 2026-05-15 to 09-19, First-come, First-served 2026-09-20 to 09-26), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Recreation.gov or 877-444-6777 at least four days ahead, for the 2026 season May 15 - Sept 19 (2027: May 14 - Sept 18); some sites are first-come and must be occupied the first night. Reservations need Friday and Saturday nights on weekends and three nights on holiday weekends; walk-ups are exempt. 14 consecutive nights at most.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/purgatoire-campground ('Call 877-444-6777 or visit recreation.gov at least four days in advance. A minimum stay on Friday and Saturday night is required on weekends. A three-night minimum stay is required on holiday weekends. Walk-ups are exempt'; 'No more than a 14-night consecutive stay') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234104 (facility_rules minWeekendStay 2, minHolidayWeekendStay 3, maxConsecutiveStay 14, reservationCutOff 4; 'This facility also has first-come, first-served campsites'; 8 of 20 catalog sites Not Reservable) + /rates (Peak Season 2026-05-15 to 09-19, 2027-05-14 to 09-18), read 2026-10-26

note: San Carlos RD, Pike-San Isabel NF: 9,800 ft in aspen and spruce near the headwaters of the Purgatoire (North Fork) in the Culebra Range, 25 mi south of La Veta off CO-12 and 4 mi of rough gravel up County Road 34. North Fork Trail #1309 trailhead at the north end. Remote: no real-time information. --Claude
summary: Fees $25 confirmed (FS + rec.gov 2026/2027). Sites count 20 kept; max_rig_ft 45 -> 35 (45 is an equestrian-only site; the standard/RV sites run 18-35 ft). Season: closes 09-19 (calendar-derived) -> early May to late September on the FS page, dated 05-08 to 09-26 from rec.gov's 2026 operating seasons. Added vault toilets, hand-pump potable water, booking on rec.gov (4-day cutoff, some FCFS, 2/3-night weekend/holiday minimums for reservations, 14-night max, booking season 05-15 to 09-19). Hookups left (catalog: none). Pin 51 m from the catalog centroid. Note: dropped the site count/length/reservable repeats; district is San Carlos RD per the FS page.
